core_categories: Pharmacy and Healthcare; Vitamins and Supplements; Beauty and Skincare; Personal Care
specialty_focus: BinSina Pharmacy is a leading pharmacy and retail chain in the UAE and Oman, operating over 120 stores. It specializes in a 'Health Meets Beauty' philosophy, curating top international health, nutrition, and derma-cosmetic brands, and providing community-centric retail with both mall-based stores and digital delivery options. It is part of Al Khayyat Investments (AKI) and partners with leading global principals to distribute pharmaceuticals, wellness, and beauty brands across the UAE.
key_brands: Holland & Barrett, La Roche-Posay, Vichy, Nuxe, Corine De Farme, others
